decision: Announced lineage-only successor for the jankurai rustunsafe cap (#1782), which replaced libc getsockopt(SO_PEERCRED) and waitid in crates/jope-engine/src/eval_registry/authority.rs with nix safe wrappers but merged without recording the lineage source that jope-engine hashes into the teaching-store semantic_dependencies_sha256; compat_freeze lineage_sources has been red on origin/main since. The identity-only regeneration records the new authority.rs hash. Evaluator implementation hash, Cargo.lock hash, evaluator identity digest, DSL ABI, evaluator calculations and behavior fixtures are unchanged; the evaluator identity fixture changes only its generation SHA. No known-identity row is added without a shipped receipt.
plan_reference: jankurai rustunsafe cap (#1782); ADR-0004 and compat_freeze identity-only procedure
